title: cps-okf — Bundle root frontmatter (OKF-CPS profile v0.1)
description: Frontmatter of the ROOT index.md — the only place base OKF permits index frontmatter. Declares the format version and carries the organizational GLOSSARY (axis 5), which binds the org's vocabulary to canonical types/statuses/fields for the whole bundle.

okf_version.description: Base-OKF version this bundle targets, e.g. '0.1'.

okf_cps_profile.description: OKF-CPS profile version, e.g. '0.1-cps'. Additive-only within a 0.x line.

glossary.description: AXIS 5 — Vocabulary. Bidirectional binding of org nomenclature to canonical vocabulary, built from the account's real labels (ClearPoint /scorecards/{id}/language + /menu). Used on INGEST (understand the org's words) and on PROJECTION (speak the org's words back).

types.description: org term -> canonical objectType, e.g. { "OKR": "objective", "KPI": "measure" }. Sourced from the language overrides for each element type.

labels.description: General term overrides that aren't element types — e.g. { "children": "Divisions", "goals": "OKRs" }. The org's word for a concept/relationship, from /language.

statuses.description: org status label -> canonical status, e.g. { "Green": "On Track", "Red": "Off Track" }.
